items.title: Natty Dominique Interview, 1958-05-31
items.q: Lorenzo Teo, Papatio, Backe, Sidney Dance, Fane, no nobody. He was Johnny Dodds in person.

ctx.x: Well, let's see. If there's anything you can tell about Johnny Dodds that you've done. No.

No, no, no, no. You're talking about my boy, Johnny Dodds. Well, Johnny Dodds. I haven't heard of Clanness player yet, but the United States of America got a style like Johnny Dodds. Am I right, Bill? That's right. That's one. Johnny, what I liked about Johnny had its own style. He didn't try to imitate Benny Goodman. Didn't try to imitate Benny Biggert. Lorenzo Teo, Papatio, Backe, Sidney Dance, Fane, no nobody. He was Johnny Dodds in person. And only Johnny Dodds. Who'd never be forgotten because he had a style…
